verdict_reason: Contact-address assertions are correctly removed, but three unrelated amend tests for the permanent address and CPH pages were deleted with them, leaving that behaviour without e2e coverage.

todos.issue: The PR deletes three amend tests that main has and that have nothing to do with the contact page: 'while amending, the permanent address page ends with Save and continue alone', 'Cancel amend ... from the permanent address page', and the CPH half of 'Cancel amend ... from the CPH number page and the contact address page'. Nothing else in the suite asserts permanentAddress.formButtons, permanentAddress.cancelAmend or cphNumber.cancelAmend (grep of tests/ at 47d3968 finds none). SCN-FLOW-013-D still says the permanent address page offers Save and continue alone while amending, and its e2e link was dropped with the test.
todos.fix: Must: the permanent address amend ending, and Cancel amend from the CPH number and permanent address pages, are still proved by e2e tests, and SCN-FLOW-013-D links the permanent address one again. One way: restore the two permanent address tests from main as they were, and keep the CPH half of the Cancel amend test under a title naming only the CPH number page.
